shared_elements: standing human figure with raised/extended arms
figures organised into stacked horizontal registers
a repeated row of near-identical motifs across the top
long horizontal band of short parallel strokes / linear hatching
reddish-brown colouring against a pale stone ground
justification: Both surfaces stack schematic animal and human figures into horizontal registers, and each is topped by a row of repeated near-identical motifs above a band of short parallel strokes, which is the most specific correspondence. However, A is a carved three-dimensional relief on a shaped pillar with volumetric, individualised beasts, while B is a flat rock panel of thin painted outline drawings dominated by boats and an abstract grid, so the manner of rendering and the actual subject matter differ almost entirely.
